an4.274:1.1: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā. Katame cattāro? Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ, vedanāsu . . . citte . . . dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā ti.
